text: My main symptom is Generalized erythematous maculopapular rash and pustules. I also have Rash with an erythematous base, Rash over the trunk and extremities, Sparing of the palms and soles.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Gonococcal Dermatitis. The clinical presentation of a 4-day-old with a pustular rash on an erythematous base, involving the trunk and extremities but sparing the palms and soles, in the context of maternal gonorrhea history, is classic for disseminated gonococcal infection in a neonate.
